name: w3c-offline-html-validator
description: A VSCode extension for offline HTML validation using W3C standards.

offlineW3C.autoOpenProblems.description: Automatically open the Problems pane when there are validation errors.

offlineW3C.noStream.description: VNU option: Forces all documents to be parsed in buffered mode instead of streaming mode (causes some parse errors to be treated as non-fatal document errors instead of as fatal document errors).

offlineW3C.noLangDetect.description: VNU option: Disables language detection, so that documents are not checked for missing or mislabeled html[lang] attributes.

offlineW3C.enableDebugLogging.description: Enable debug logging to the VSCode developer console.

scripts.cpp: npm run vscode:prepublish && vsce package && vsce publish
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
